items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Official weekend injury summary and team downgrade after limited practice.
items.implication: Ravens pass game downgraded; Flowers/Andrews/Likely less upside without Lamar.
items.opportunity: Huntley start caps ceiling for skill players.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf; optimism from feeling better Saturday.
items.why: ETR summary GTD/optimism; Schefter/Rapoport/Berry confirmed active.
items.implication: Must-start WR1 with full role expected; Stafford upside restored.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then inactive vs Dolphins after limited practice returning from quad; unlikely per sources.
items.why: ETR pessimism; Rapoport unlikely, Schefter listed inactive.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full workload RB1 upside in good matchup.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT for MNF vs Cowboys; Saquon expected to play.
items.why: Official ETR summary; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed Smith out, Saquon expected.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thin; Goedert/A.J. Brown targets surge, Saquon volume secure if active.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for remaining pass-catchers and Barkley carries.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; watched post-game after expected lead-back role.
items.why: Levitan assessment after ETR watch and game (124 yds/TD but injury note).
items.implication: Monitor for next week; Tracy or others could benefit if limited.
items.conflict: Pre-game expected full lead; Berry hated matchup.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Direct response to ETR injury watch; slide was correct/purposeful.
items.implication: No downgrade; maintain elite RB1 status ROS/weekly.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated/IN and expected to play for Packers vs Lions after layoff.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter activated expected to play.
items.implication: Workload question post-layoff but RB2/flex viable; committee risk.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup; Bears soft vs WRs, Brown back in real role.
items.why: Usage rebound and favorable Bears matchup.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; elevated with Smith out.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET post-layoff; workload uncertainty after long absence.
items.why: Rust and possible committee after IR return.

items.text: Xavier Worthy led Chiefs WRs with 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rashee Rice; never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.implication: Volume leader but efficiency/history caps upside; watch for breakout or fade.
items.opportunity: High route share/target potential in Rice absence.

items.text: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23, AD Mitchell 18 on 33 Geno dropbacks with Mitchell back; Cooper efficient on limited prior routes.
items.implication: Wilson still clear alpha; Cooper emerging as deep threat/flex.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet (9 TDs allowed), Kraft high volume spot.
Hates Rome Odunze vs NE; 90% outside targets likely shadowed by Gonzalez, low floor history.
items.why: Tough shadow matchup and inconsistent production.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for workloads in friendly matchups; Saquon if active vs DAL.
items.why: Consistent volume + soft run Ds; Saquon efficient when healthy.
